long_biography.plain_text:
At Triad-Egypt Corporation, Sami Fadel Barakat served on the board of a Luxembourg holding company with an international investment remit. In 1997, he served alongside the lawyers Pierre Berna and Adel Barakat, based in Luxembourg and Geneva respectively. The company’s purpose encompassed acquiring and managing stakes in other businesses, securities and intellectual property.

His earlier management work involved Adnan Khashoggi’s Swiss company, Management & Control, which he ran during the 1980s. He also acted as a managing agent of one of the corporations holding legal title to a group of four Manhattan properties.
